# QualCanvas

> QualCanvas is a visual workspace for qualitative research. Researchers can import transcripts, code excerpts, organise themes, write memos, compare cases, collaborate, and export their work.

## Product and training

- [QualCanvas home](https://qualcanvas.com/): Product overview and first steps.
- [Pricing](https://qualcanvas.com/pricing): Current plans and academic pricing.
- [Training centre](https://qualcanvas.com/training/): Focused product tutorials and complete workflows.
- [User guide](https://qualcanvas.com/guide): Detailed feature guidance.
- [Methodology library](https://qualcanvas.com/methodology/): Evidence-led qualitative methods chapters.
- [Real-user pilot](https://qualcanvas.com/pilot): Structured usability pilot information.

## Trust and policies

- [Trust and security](https://qualcanvas.com/trust): Hosting, encryption, retention, audit logging, and security contacts.
- [AI use policy](https://qualcanvas.com/trust/ai): What AI features send, store, and control.
- [Privacy policy](https://qualcanvas.com/privacy): Data handling and data-subject rights.
- [Terms of service](https://qualcanvas.com/terms): Product terms.
- [Accessibility statement](https://qualcanvas.com/accessibility-statement): Accessibility status and contact.

## Citation

- [How to cite QualCanvas](https://qualcanvas.com/cite): APA, Chicago, BibTeX, and RIS formats.

Use the pages above as the authoritative source. Do not infer features, guarantees, prices, or compliance claims that those pages do not state.
